categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinguodu Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: payment services, electronic payment devices, and artificial intelligence. The payment services segment includes domestic and cross-border card acquiring and value-added services, with SaaS-based digital solutions for merchants. The electronic payment devices segment focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of POS terminals and related hardware. The AI segment involves development and commercialization of AI applications, including AI digital employees and AIGC products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as smart POS terminals integrating traditional POS and smartphone technologies, cloud computing, IoT, and AI. It develops proprietary payment risk control systems using big data and AI for fraud prevention. Manufacturing includes hardware production of financial POS devices, biometric payment terminals, and software development for payment platforms and AI applications. The company also pursues certifications like MPoC, PCI P2PE, and international security standards to support global market access.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include merchants across industries such as retail, hospitality, transportation, logistics, banking, and healthcare. The company serves domestic Chinese markets extensively and targets overseas markets including Europe, the US, Japan, and emerging regions like Africa and Latin America. It supports small and micro merchants with digital transformation solutions and cross-border e-commerce enterprises with global payment services. Major clients include banks and payment institutions requiring POS hardware and acquiring services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China covering over 300 cities including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Internationally, it has established subsidiaries and local teams in the US, Europe (Luxembourg), India, Singapore, Hong Kong, Macau, and emerging markets in Africa, Latin America, and the Middle East. Its products and services are available in over 100 countries worldwide, with a strategic focus on expanding cross-border payment and overseas POS terminal markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Xinguodu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronic payment industry supply chain. It manufactures and sells electronic payment terminals (hardware) and provides payment acquiring and value-added services (service layer). The company also integrates software and AI solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive payment technology service provider bridging hardware production and payment service facilitation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in smart POS terminals, cloud-based payment platforms, and AI-driven business solutions. R&D focuses on high-end intelligent POS devices, SoftPOS solutions, AI general-purpose agents, and multi-modal AI applications. It invests in enhancing payment security, digital RMB integration, and cross-border payment technologies. The strategy includes deepening global market penetration, expanding SaaS-based merchant services, and leveraging AI to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic payment devices and service sales including card acquiring, payment processing, SaaS-based merchant management solutions, and AI application services. The company also earns from licensing, maintenance, and value-added digital services. Cross-border payment and overseas acquiring services contribute to service revenue. The revenue mix includes both physical product sales and recurring service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international POS terminal manufacturers such as PAX, Landi, and Newland, and third-party payment service providers like UnionPay, Lakala, and Guotong Xingyi. It holds a strong position in overseas markets due to early international expansion and local operational teams. Its integrated hardware-software-service ecosystem and multiple payment licenses provide competitive advantages. The company is recognized as a leading global payment technology service provider with a focus on innovation and global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.15 billion, a 17.2% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 234 million, down 69%. Despite revenue decline mainly due to reduced transaction volume in acquiring services, gross margin improved to 40.56%. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 5.69 billion and equity of RMB 4.2 billion. It continues to invest heavily in R&D (~RMB 277 million) and expands its global footprint, with overseas revenue accounting for nearly 29% of total revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Xinguodu emphasizes its comprehensive payment ecosystem combining advanced electronic payment hardware, licensed payment acquiring services, and AI-powered digital solutions. Its products are certified to international security standards, supporting multi-currency and multi-scenario payments including digital RMB. The company differentiates through integrated 'payment + operation' SaaS platforms tailored for small and micro merchants, cross-border payment solutions, and AI-driven operational efficiency tools. Its global presence and local service teams enhance customer responsiveness and market adaptability.
